Here is the tally: D1 x2, D2 x1, D3 x3, D4 x1, D5 x4 (11 doors) and W1 x2, W2 x4, W3 x6, W4 x1, W5 x2, W6 x2 (17 windows), 28 openings in all., *** IT ALSO CONFIRMS THE MATERIAL SPLIT READ OFF A-22/A-23 EXACTLY: D1 is the only ALUMINIUM door (the 3.10 m living-room slider) and D2-D5 are UPVC; every window W1-W6 is aluminium. *** That is precisely what the two schedules specify., The BOQ marks are D1..D5 and W1..W6, whereas the architectural sheets number them ประตู 1..5 and หน้าต่าง 1..6 inside symbol outlines. Same items, different notation -- the D/W prefix is what removes the ambiguity the plans left., W3 at 6 units is the most common opening -- the 0.60 m single casement, which fits its use as a secondary light in bedrooms and service rooms., Every line is measured in ชุด (sets), i.e. frame, sash, glass and hardware complete, matching the way A-22/A-23 specify each type.

data.file_warnings: *** EXTRACTION METHOD FOR THIS SHEET -- READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING IT. *** The two BOQ sets in this book (ฐานรากแผ่ at PNG 71-87 and ฐานรากเข็มตอก at PNG 88-104) are the SAME 34-sheet ปร.4 template issued twice, differing only in (a) the foundation name in the title line and (b) the foundation item inside หมวดงานโครงสร้าง. The page mapping is exact and one-to-one: set-2 PNG = set-1 PNG + 17, same physical half, same แผ่นที่ n/34. That mapping and the line-for-line identity of the non-structural categories were VERIFIED VISUALLY at ten points spanning the whole range: 88_1 (1/34), 88_2 (2/34), 89_1 (3/34), 89_2 (4/34), 90_1 (5/34), 90_2 (6/34), 91_1 (7/34), 95_2 (16/34), 99_1 (23/34), 104_2 (34/34). This particular sheet's rows were NOT re-read from its own PNG; they were carried across from the verified-identical ฐานรากแผ่ counterpart named in derived_from. Anyone using this file for anything quantity-critical should re-read its own PNG first., PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json., EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented., The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank., *** THIS IS THE LUMINAIRE SCHEDULE THE ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS NEVER PROVIDE: 7 batten fittings, 33 downlights and 8 wall lights, 48 luminaires in all. *** EE-03 and EE-04 draw the positions but carry no schedule, so the counts on those two files were read off the symbols and flagged count_read_from_symbols. These are the authoritative numbers., The luminaire descriptions are copied from EE-01's legend almost verbatim, including the performance minima -- 1,600 lm and 25,000 h for the battens, 600 lm for the E27 lamps, COOL WHITE against WARM WHITE., *** ONE FIGURE DISAGREES: the BOQ says the batten lamp is 'ไม่เกิน 1-10W' where EE-01 says 'ไม่เกิน 1-20 วัตต์'. *** A 1,600 lm LED T8 is more consistent with 20 W than 10 W, so EE-01 is the likelier correct value -- but neither is corrected. Both are recorded as printed and flagged., *** THE CABLE QUANTITIES ARE THE LARGEST NUMBERS IN THE ELECTRICAL BOQ: 1,396 m of IEC01 2.5 sq.mm. *** Against 423 m of ø15 conduit that is about 3.3 conductors per conduit metre -- consistent with EE-01's '2-2.5, G-2.5' (two cores plus earth) in every circuit., 48 m of NYY 10 sq.mm against EE-02's 'ประมาณ 20 เมตร' service run: the run is TWO-CORE ('2-1/C-10 NYY'), so 2 x 20 m = 40 m plus terminations gives 48 m. The two figures are consistent once the core count is applied -- a good cross-check., IEC01 10 sq.mm at 2 m is the earth conductor from the board to the rod, matching EE-02's '1-10 IEC 01 in ø15 มม. PVC'., 'BLUB' for 'BULB' is printed on the downlight line; transcribed as printed.
